description: Source code for QboneClientSession class implementing a QUIC protocol session with control stream management, crypto stream creation, and packet processing.

classes.name: QboneClientSession
classes.description: A class managing a QBONE client session over QUIC, handling control stream creation, crypto setup, and packet processing.

methods.name: CreateCryptoStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a new QuicCryptoClientStream for the session.

methods.name: CreateControlStream
methods.description: Creates and activates the control stream if not already created.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session, sets up crypto, and optionally creates the control stream based on command line flags.

methods.name: SetDefaultEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Sets the default encryption level and creates control stream if conditions are met.

methods.name: GetNumSentClientHellos
methods.description: Returns the number of client hello messages sent.

methods.name: EarlyDataAccepted
methods.description: Checks if early data was accepted.

methods.name: ReceivedInchoateReject
methods.description: Checks if an inchoate reject was received.

methods.name: GetNumReceivedServerConfigUpdates
methods.description: Returns the number of server config update messages received.

methods.name: SendServerRequest
methods.description: Sends a server request via the control stream.

methods.name: ProcessPacketFromNetwork
methods.description: Processes incoming packets from the network.

methods.name: ProcessPacketFromPeer
methods.description: Processes packets received from the peer and writes them to the network.

methods.name: OnProofValid
methods.description: Callback for when proof is validated.

methods.name: OnProofVerifyDetailsAvailable
methods.description: Callback for when proof verification details are available.

methods.name: HasActiveRequests
methods.description: Checks if there are active requests or streams.
